abstract_zh: 野生候鸟在病毒的全球传播中发挥着重要作用,但支撑病毒多样性和 传播 的生态驱动因素,特别是 宿主 行为,仍然知之甚少。新西兰提供了一个强大的系统来解决这个问题,其中包括反映其地理隔离的独特物种,但跨越东亚-澳大利亚迁徙路线和南极地区的候鸟提供了国际联系。在此,我们对新西兰及其亚南极岛屿的 野生鸟类 进行了大规模的宏转录组调查,其中我们收集了来自 4 个鸟类目 31 个 宿主 物种的 690 个人的 1,348 个样本。我们鉴定出来自 17 个科的 118 种禽病毒,其中包括 107 个新物种,扩大了我们对禽病毒多样性的认识。值得注意的是,病毒群落组成与鸟类食腐行为密切相关,这比 宿主 分类学、地理或迁徙状态解释了更多的变异。食腐鸟类和机会性食腐动物比非食腐动物拥有更多样化的病毒组,这与营养级病毒暴露的增加一致。检测到 12 种哺乳动物相关病毒(主要存在于食腐动物中)支持了这一点,包括刺猬肝病毒、兔出血性疾病病毒 2 和海狮星状病毒,宿主 序列数据证实了饮食来源。我们还检测到了具有流行病学和进化意义的病毒,包括来自红滨鹬 (Calidris canutus) 的低致病性 禽流感 A(H1N9) 病毒和来自奥克兰岛水鸭 (Anas aucklandica) 的不同托巴尼病毒,后者代表了托巴尼病毒科中第一个假定的鸟类成员。这些发现表明,野生鸟类 中的病毒体结构与清除行为相关,从而凸显了将 宿主 生态学纳入病毒 监测 和风险评估的重要性。

title: Influenza A virus neuraminidase-GRP78 binding site prediction.
abstract: Previous research has shown that there is an interaction between Influenza A viral surface neuraminidase (NA) and the host endoplasmic reticulum chaperone GRP78 in the early phases of NA production in the endoplasmic reticulum. In this study, we predict the binding sites of neuraminidase for H1N1, H3N2, and H5N1 strains. We select 13 conserved, cysteine-cyclized regions, one of which is hypothesized to be a possible binding site for GRP78. Using the grand average hydrophobicity index (GRAVY), we focus only on specific highlighted hydrophobic regions, which match the profile of the cyclic peptide, Pep42. Protein-protein docking analysis using HADDOCK suggests that region VIII (C278:C291) is the best possible binding site with the substrate-binding domain β (SBDβ) of GRP78. Subsequently, MDS runs for 150 ns are conducted, and MM-GBSA calculations are done for the three complexes (-7.10, -22.22, and -11.26 kcal/mol for H1N1, H3N2, and H5N1, respectively). The results indicate that GRP78 remains associated with the NA of H3N2, whereas the NAs of H1N1 and H5N1 dissociate from GRP78 during the simulation. Our findings show that region VIII is a potential therapeutic target for neutralizing the viral neuraminidase of seasonal H3N2 flu.
journal: Journal of Biomolecular Structure and Dynamics

title: The evolution of EID pandemics from a planning perspective
abstract: This chapter applies the theoretical concepts outlined in prior chapters to the outbreaks of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) in Vietnam during the early 2000s, examining how rapid land use changes influenced disease dynamics. This study explores the specific contributions of peri-urbanization and agricultural consolidation to increased HPAI risk in affected regions. It analyzes how existing planning infrastructure and governance mechanisms responded to the challenge, evaluating their effectiveness in managing an emerging infectious disease threat. This research highlights critical lessons for urban and regional planners, offering insights into developing more resilient systems and effective response strategies for future zoonotic disease outbreaks. These findings underscore the necessity of integrating public health considerations into spatial planning to mitigate the risks associated with evolving human-animal interactions in changing landscapes.

title: Genetic Characteristics and Pathogenicity of Recent G4 Eurasian Avian-like H1N1 Swine Influenza Viruses in China
abstract: G4 Eurasian avian-like H1N1 (G4 EA-H1N1) swine influenza viruses continue to be detected in pigs in China and remain a concern because of their reassortant genomes and zoonotic potential. Here, six H1N1 viruses isolated from pigs with respiratory disease in six Chinese provinces during 2023–2025 were characterized. Phylogenetic analysis showed that all six isolates belonged to the G4 genotype and retained the characteristic genomic constellation, with EA-lineage HA and NA genes, pdm09-derived PB2, PB1, PA, NP, and M segments, and a triple-reassortant NS segment. Sequence analysis identified amino acid substitutions in HA antigenic and receptor-binding-associated regions and differences in predicted HA and NA glycosylation patterns. Molecular docking indicated that the HAs could accommodate both α2,3- and α2,6-linked sialic acid receptor analogs. Hemagglutination inhibition testing of 96 field swine sera showed that 62 samples (64.6%) had titers ≥ 1:40 against the representative isolate JS0602, with seroreactivity to JS0602 detected among sera from all sampled regions. JS0602 replicated efficiently in MDCK cells and caused respiratory signs, pulmonary lesions, viral antigen deposition, and viral shedding in experimentally infected pigs. These findings provide updated genetic and biological information on contemporary G4 EA-H1N1 viruses and support continued surveillance in swine populations.

title: Consensus H3N2 HA immunogens incorporating key antigenic mutations elicit broad-spectrum neutralising responses
abstract: Seasonal influenza A/H3N2 poses a significant public health burden due to its rapid antigenic evolution, necessitating frequent vaccine updates. This study systematically analysed the antigenic evolution of 14 H3N2 vaccine strains (2000-2022) using pseudovirus-based neutralisation assays and antigenic cartography. Vaccine strains exhibited cross-neutralisation patterns, with higher reactivity among strains from adjacent years, forming six antigenic clusters. Key amino acid mutations (e.g., 144 K, 189N) were identified as critical drivers of antigenic variation, with clustering-specific effects on neutralisation sensitivity. Based on these findings, a consensus HA immunogen (consensus up-HA) was designed by combining mutations at key sites. This immunogen demonstrated broad-spectrum neutralisation against pseudoviruses representing circulating strains from 2011 to 2024, including recent variants. source_records.abstract: Seasonal influenza A/H3N2 poses a significant public health burden due to its rapid antigenic evolution, necessitating frequent vaccine updates. These results highlight the potential of targeted HA modifications to develop broadly cross-reactive H3N2 vaccine candidate, offering broader and more durable neutralising activity against evolving H3N2 strains.

title: Introduction
abstract: This chapter advocates an ecosystem-based approach to preventing global pandemics like COVID-19, emphasizing urban and regional planning’s role in mitigating risks from human-animal interactions and rapid urbanization. It highlights how factors such as agricultural intensification, habitat loss, and global connectivity create disease hotspots, turning local outbreaks into worldwide threats. Drawing on examples like avian influenza, it critiques reactive medical strategies and urges proactive policies, including zoning for safer land use and transportation management. Overall, it positions planners as key to integrating science with policy for a resilient global urban ecosystem, estimating trillions in potential economic savings. By delving into the challenges of unknown risks associated with emerging infectious diseases, adding an ecosystem approach to strictly human health and medical interventions, as well as articulating an associated research agenda, this book details a conceptual framework and associated policy implications designed to bring the skills and expertise of planners to efforts to understand and mitigate future pandemic risks.

full_text: Abstract Background H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) has been widely spreading among poultry populations for decades. The decline in poultry production performance and the cross-species adaptability it causes will continue to pose threats to the poultry industry and public health. To investigate the prevalence of H9N2 AIV in southeastern China, this study conducted an epidemiological investigation of H9N2 AIV circulating in live poultry markets in Fujian Province, selecting three representative H9N2 virus strains for molecular evolutionary and biological characterization. Results Analysis of the three strains revealed that their HA genes all belonged to the typical B-like lineage, and the NA genes of strains FZ26 and FZ83 originated from the H6N2 subtype, indicating frequent natural reassortment events, and molecular marker analysis revealed mutations at key receptor-binding sites that enhance affinity for human-type receptors. Animal experiments demonstrated that these three H9N2 viruses exhibited certain pathogenicity in chickens but did not cause mortality, suggesting they are low pathogenic viruses. Infected chickens displayed mild clinical symptoms, mainly respiratory-related signs such as head shaking and sneezing. Viral load detection revealed that all three viruses replicated efficiently in the respiratory tissues of chickens, especially in the trachea and lungs. The virus persisted in oropharyngeal and cloacal secretions, with oropharyngeal swabs showing significantly higher viral loads than cloacal swabs, and virus shedding lasted for an extended period. Additionally, histopathological examination found varying degrees of tissue damage in the trachea and lungs of infected chickens. Conclusions In summary, although these three H9N2 virus strains exhibited low pathogenicity, their stable replication ability in the respiratory tract and significant viral shedding characteristics indicate strong transmissibility and potential epidemic risk. These findings highlight the necessity of strengthening virus surveillance and prevention measures in live poultry markets and provide a scientific basis for avian influenza control strategies. abstract_zh: 为研究H9N2禽流感病毒(AIV)在华东地区(患病率)的流行情况,本研究对福建省活禽市场中流行的H9N2 AIV进行了流行病学调查,选取了三种具有代表性的H9N2病毒株进行分子进化和生物学特征分析。结果分析显示,这三种病毒株的HA基因均属于典型的B样系,其中FZ26和FZ83病毒株的NA基因来源于H6N2亚型,表明存在频繁的自然重配事件。分子标记分析显示,在关键受体结合位点存在突变,增强了对人类型受体的亲和力。这些发现强调了在活禽市场中加强病毒监测和预防措施的必要性,并为禽流感防控策略提供了科学依据。伦理声明伦理审批和参与同意动物实验中使用的实验方案已获得福建农林大学动物科学学院研究伦理委员会的批准(许可号:禽流感)。摘要背景H9N2亚型禽流感病毒(AIV)已在禽类群体中广泛传播数十年。其导致的禽类生产性能下降以及跨物种适应性将继续对禽类产业和公共卫生构成威胁。动物实验表明,这三种H9N2病毒在鸡中表现出一定的致病性,但并未引起死亡率,提示它们属于低致病性病毒。感染的鸡表现出轻微的临床症状,主要为与呼吸系统相关的症状,如摇头和打喷嚏。病毒载量检测显示,这三种病毒在鸡的呼吸组织中能够高效复制。

In multivariable analysis, factors sig- nificantly associated with greater fatigue included younger age (OR: 0.98, 95% CI: 0.98–0.99, p<0.001), female sex (OR: 1.38, 95% CI: 1.21–1.57, p<0.001), current smoking (OR: 1.19, 95% CI: 1.05– 1.36, p=0.008), diabetes mellitus (OR: 1.34, 95% CI: 1.1–-1.54, p<0.001), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (OR: 1.37, 95% CI: 1.16–1.62, p<0.001), and mood disorders (OR: 1.96, 95% CI: 1.72–2.23, p<0.001). DISCUSSION/SIGNIFICANCE OF IMPACT: This is among the first studies to examine PSF using large, representative datasets. With 84% reporting symptoms, findings reveal under recognition in clinical settings and identify modifiable risk factors to guide targeted, evidence-based interventions. 536 Immunopathogenesis of Avian Influenza in the mammalian mammary gland Micah Yaeggi, Clara Cole, Thomas Cleven, Laura Hernandez and Marulasiddappa Suresh University of Wisconsin-Madison OBJECTIVES/GOALS: Our aim is to determine the pathogenesis of intramammary infection of H5N1. First, we must induce lactation, and our aim was to create a protocol to induce lactation without impregnating mice. We hypothesize that the immunological milieu of a lactating mammary gland is highly conducive for influenza viral infection. METHODS/STUDY POPULATION: Nine 10-week-old female mice of unidentified strain were placed in cohorts of lactating versus non-lactating versus control (undeveloped mammary glands) groups. Animals were co-housed within their group. Lactogenic hor- mones were used to induce mammary development and lactation, including estradiol, progesterone, oxytocin, and prolactin. Mice were inoculated with a comparative strain to H5N1, H1N1, due to its increased availability and safety standards. Immunopathology of mammary tissues and lungs will be assessed by histology, viral titra- tion, and flow cytometry, and data analysis is pending. RESULTS/ ANTICIPATED RESULTS: All seven mice that were chosen to be injected with lactogenic hormones developed mammary tissue beyond the pubertal stage and into the reproductive stage, as expected if they were pregnant. Of those seven mice, the three that were given prolactin and oxytocin for milk production and let down were able to lactate. Plaque assays of mammary and lung tissue revealed no viral titers. Flow cytometry of innate surface markers showed varying results and were deemed inconclusive. Based on the preliminary data, it is inconclusive whether the mammary tissue was able to support H1N1 virus replication. DISCUSSION/ SIGNIFICANCE OF IMPACT: Better understanding of the immu- nopathology of the mammary gland and how it contributes to disease and disease transmission of influenza in mammalian species will be essential for the development of measures to control disease outbreak and minimize economic loss, especially in species such as cattle and goats. 537 Can we identify the ideal sexual violence prevention program for each student? Leveraging implementation science to reimagine how we deliver prevention programming Rose Hennessy Garza University of Wisconsin – Milwaukee OBJECTIVES/GOALS: Analyze risk factors among college students and their likelihood of experiencing or perpetrating sexual violence. Critique the process to develop a screening tool to match students to existing programming. Examine principles of implementation sci- ence in overcoming barriers to connect each student to the most appropriate prevention programming. METHODS/STUDY POPULATION: Research questions: What needs to be in a screening tool to gauge each incoming college student’s risk factors and like- lihood for future sexual violence victimization and perpetration? How can the tool be designed using principles of implementation sci- ence with end-user feasibility in mind? For this protocol, I will ini- tiate a participatory research process to guide the development of a screening tool for incoming college students in a mid-western sample of the USA to assess risk factors for sexual violence victimization and perpetration. I will assemble a Technical Expert Panel to develop the screening tool using existing standardized measures. I aim to recruit a diverse panel of researchers and practitioners in sexual violence prevention, including sexual assault survivors and peer educators. RESULTS/ANTICIPATED RESULTS: The anticipated result will be a screening tool to predict the likelihood of victimization and per- petration for each incoming college student over one academic year. Next steps would be to pilot-test the screening tool to determine its effectiveness. The long-term goal would be to match each student to the most appropriate evidence-based prevention program based on individualized screening results. This could include existing evi- dence-based programs that prevent or decrease severity of victimi- zation, revictimization, alcohol-facilitated victimization, perpetration, perpetration among high-risk students, and perpetra- tion among fraternity members. Considering barriers and stake- holder engagement from the onset of the project aims to increase the feasibility of implementation in practice. DISCUSSION/ SIGNIFICANCE OF IMPACT: Quantifying an approximation of how many students would benefit from which types of programming can help colleges determine where to invest their time and resources to best prevent sexual violence. Guiding each incoming student to the most appropriate evidence-based prevention program could decrease rates of campus sexual violence. 538 Implementing depression screening services in appointment-based pharmacies: A qualitative observational feasibility study Brandy Davis, Natalie Hohmann, Brent Fox and Lindsey Hohmann Auburn University JCTS 2026 Abstract Supplement 167

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 84% 的人报告了症状,研究结果揭示了临床环境中未得到认可的问题,并确定了可改变的风险因素,以指导有针对性的、基于证据的干预措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 参与者通过电子健康记录进行了调查,84% 的人在调查中报告了一定程度的疲劳。
elements_zh.methods: 方法/研究群体:将 9 只 10 周龄的不明品系雌性小鼠放入 队列研究 哺乳期组、非哺乳期组和对照组(未发育的乳腺)。
elements_zh.main_results: 由于其可用性和安全标准更高,因此给小鼠接种了与 H5N1、H1N1 相当的毒株。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 讨论/影响意义:这是首批利用大规模、有代表性的数据集研究PSF的文献之一。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 讨论/影响意义:更好地理解乳腺免疫病理学以及它如何导致哺乳动物物种中流感的疾病传播和疾病暴发将是开发控制疾病措施和最小化经济损失的关键,尤其是在牛和山羊等物种中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 根据初步数据,尚无法确定乳腺组织是否能够支持H1N1病毒的复制。

analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Based on the preliminary data, it is inconclusive whether the mammary tissue was able to support H1N1 virus replication.

source_body_en: With 84% reporting symptoms, findings reveal under recognition in clinical settings and identify modifiable risk factors to guide targeted, evidence-based interventions. METHODS/STUDY POPULATION: Nine 10-week-old female mice of unidentified strain were placed in cohorts of lactating versus non-lactating versus control (undeveloped mammary glands) groups. RESULTS/ ANTICIPATED RESULTS: All seven mice that were chosen to be injected with lactogenic hormones developed mammary tissue beyond the pubertal stage and into the reproductive stage, as expected if they were pregnant. Flow cytometry of innate surface markers showed varying results and were deemed inconclusive. METHODS/STUDY POPULATION: Research questions: What needs to be in a screening tool to gauge each incoming college student’s risk factors and like- lihood for future sexual violence victimization and perpetration? RESULTS/ANTICIPATED RESULTS: The anticipated result will be a screening tool to predict the likelihood of victimization and per- petration for each incoming college student over one academic year. The long-term goal would be to match each student to the most appropriate evidence-based prevention program based on individualized screening results. participants through electronic health records, while 84% reported some level of fatigue on surveys. In multivariable analysis, factors sig- nificantly associated with greater fatigue included younger age (OR: 0.98, 95% CI: 0.98–0.99, p<0.001), female sex (OR: 1.38, 95% CI: 1.21–1.57, p<0.001), current smoking (OR: 1.19, 95% CI: 1.05– 1.36, p=0.008), diabetes mellitus (OR: 1.34, 95% CI: 1.1–-1.54, p<0.001), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (OR: 1.37, 95% CI: 1.16–1.62, p<0.001), and mood disorders (OR: 1.96, 95% CI: 1.72–2.23, p<0.001). analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 84% 的人报告了症状,研究结果揭示了临床环境中未得到认可的问题,并确定了可改变的风险因素,以指导有针对性的、基于证据的干预措施。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 参与者通过电子健康记录进行了调查,84% 的人在调查中报告了一定程度的疲劳。
analysis_zh.methods: 方法/研究群体:将 9 只 10 周龄的不明品系雌性小鼠放入 队列研究 哺乳期组、非哺乳期组和对照组(未发育的乳腺)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 由于其可用性和安全标准更高,因此给小鼠接种了与 H5N1、H1N1 相当的毒株。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 讨论/影响意义:这是首批利用大规模、有代表性的数据集研究PSF的文献之一。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 讨论/影响意义:更好地理解乳腺免疫病理学以及它如何导致哺乳动物物种中流感的疾病传播和疾病暴发将是开发控制疾病措施和最小化经济损失的关键,尤其是在牛和山羊等物种中。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 根据初步数据,尚无法确定乳腺组织是否能够支持H1N1病毒的复制。
